letter.subject: Civil Drafter, Melbourne (Requisition 100049)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Drafter role in Melbourne (Requisition 100049) on the Hatch careers site. Your civil team's work on earthworks site grading, drainage modelling and terrain modelling for road and rail projects is the kind of drawing work I trained for, and I would like to build my drafting career there.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D applying Australian Standards. This drafting is from study rather than a paid drafting role, and I have not yet worked with MicroStation, OpenRoads or TMR standards.

Before moving to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports, material records and progress reports, which taught me how much a clear, correct drawing set matters on site.
I live in Melton and can reach your Melbourne office. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I would welcome the chance to talk about the role. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
